title: Bun as runtime
rationale: TypeScript runs natively with no build step. bun link makes lr available globally. Mirrors Mulch's choice.

title: Commander.js for CLI parsing
rationale: Same library as Mulch. Mature, typed, easy to extend per-command with registerXCommand(program) pattern.

title: JSONL one file per domain
rationale: Append-only, merge=union in .gitattributes prevents merge conflicts. Same as Mulch. Human-readable.

title: Soft-archive by default on prune
rationale: lr restore <id> brings records back. Hard delete only with --hard. Stale expertise is often still historically useful.

title: Shelf lives: tactical 90d, observational 30d
rationale: Longer than Mulch (14d/30d) — solo dev across multiple projects may go weeks without touching a codebase.

description: brew install bun fails — bun is not in homebrew core
resolution: Use official installer: curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | bash
